desc: Parse input: N, array A, array B from stdin.
Separate fixed (non -1) values of A and B; build Counters ca, cb; compute fa, fb, and maxFixed (max over all fixed values, or 0 if none).
Compute L = max(0, fa + fb - N). If L == 0, print Yes and exit.
Build hashmap h: for each distinct value v in ca and w in cb, h[v+w] += min(ca[v], cb[w]).
If any key S in h satisfies S >= maxFixed and h[S] >= L, print Yes; else print No.
Wrap in solve() with fast I/O (sys.stdin), guard edge cases (no fixed elements → Yes).
Implement and output the complete Python solution: parse stdin, build Counters of fixed values, compute L, build sum-hashmap h, decide Yes/No per the algorithm.
